description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing historical index data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameter handling, data normalization, and data transformation.

classes.name: FMPIndexHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching historical index data from FMP API, including start/end date and interval.

classes.name: FMPIndexHistoricalData
classes.description: Represents the structure of the historical index data, including VWAP, change, and change percent.

classes.name: FMPIndexHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, query transformation, and data normalization for FMP index historical data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into validated query parameters, setting default date range if not provided.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw historical data from the FMP API endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured FMPIndexHistoricalData objects, raising an error if data is empty.

methods.name: _normalize_percent
methods.description: Normalizes the change_percent value from a percentage to a decimal.
